description: Eight pigment roles. Colour is classification or state, never decoration.

paper.role: Warm ivory. Every page ground, every printed substrate.

ink.role: Charcoal. Primary text, heavy rules, pictogram stroke.

inkMuted.role: Warm gray. Secondary text, captions, metadata values.

rule.role: Mineral gray. Hairlines, specimen frames, table borders.

soil.role: Dark earth. Infill blocks, inverted panels, signage ground.

moss.role: Restrained forest green. OK / active / in-spec.

rust.role: Oxidised red-brown. Error and contamination ONLY.

warning.role: Muted ochre. Caution. Non-text use only — see audit.

mossTint.role: 12% moss on paper. OK banner ground.

rustTint.role: 12% rust on paper. Error banner ground.

warningTint.role: 12% warning on paper. Caution banner ground.

warningText.role: Same hue/sat as warning, darkened to 4.53:1 on paper. The ONLY legal ochre text colour.

statusWarn.usage: Solid fills and bars only, with textPrimary on top (6.12:1). Never text: 2.39:1 on paper.
